newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Bunds set to retreat towards 101.15 base.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Bunds set to retreat towards 101.15 base.

text.p: June Bund futures on LIFFE will head lower on Wednesday after their recent rally, but find strong support around the 101.15 area, technical analysts said.
"We're going to get a pull-back from some of the stronger gains we reached yesterday and over the last couple of days," said Ian Stannard, technical analyst at Chase in London.
He placed initial support around 101.31, an area of support early in May, but said a break below there could see further retracement targeting 101.15.
By 0715 GMT, June Bund futures were 0.09 lower at 101.36.
Stannard said the 101.15 level represented a 38.2 percent retracement of the recent rally and also coincided with an April trend support line.
"That's going to be quite a strong support area for Bunds, so if we do get a full correction of this latest rally it's likely to be limited to the 101.15 area."
Analysts at MCM Yieldwatch said in a note the market was starting to see corrective selling pressure with bearish divergence on hourly studies.
They said there was risk of a pull-back to the 101.20/101.02 area in the near term, but in the short term they looked for a test of 101.73.
On the upside Stannard said if Bunds managed to push through 101.56 this would open up a lot of scope to go higher and target 101.95, a high seen on May 19 and 21.
By 0751 GMT September Euromarks were down 0.01 at 96.74.
